svg.style: position: fixed; top: 0; left: 0; width: 100vw; height: 100vh; margin: 0; padding: 0; display: block;

foreignObject.style: position: absolute; top: 0; left: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%;

body.style: width: 100%; height: 100%; margin: 0; padding: 0; overflow: hidden; background-color: #000; color: #fff; font-family: sans-serif;
